records.complaint: Maccari judged Pio evasive, withholding information and at times untruthful during the1960inquiry.
records.basis: Luzzatto, printedpp386-387, quoting Maccari diary and report.
records.limit: Investigator’s adverse assessment; underlying question-by-question proof of deliberate falsehood not reconstructed here.

records.complaint: Excessive influence of Cleonice Morcaldi, Tina Bellone and Caterina Telfner; tolerated physical affection and privileged access.
records.limit: Some testimony and observed conduct, with disputed moral interpretation; not equivalent to established sexual intercourse.

records.complaint: Elvira Serritelli reportedly claimed a sexual relationship with Pio in1922-1930 and alleged Morcaldi replaced her.
records.limit: Reported first-person allegation, not proven affair. Luzzatto says Maccari considered her self-accusation unreliable and suspended judgment on sexual relationships. We have not inspected her complete deposition or full canonization rebuttal.

records.complaint: Maccari alleged loud speech and absent screening allowed favored women to overhear confession information and spread it.
records.basis: Maccari1991interview as reproduced by Sandro Magister29April1999.
records.limit: A substantive privacy/secrecy allegation requiring specific incidents and testimony; not a recovered established canonical verdict that Pio deliberately divulged a penitent’s sins.

records.complaint: Miracle publicity, images, publications, relic commerce and powerful lay administration formed an industry; Pio allegedly failed to restrain it and was not uninformed.
records.basis: Maccari report quoted by Luzzatto, printedpp390-392;1991interview.
records.limit: Institutional/disciplinary concerns do not establish personal enrichment, fabricated stigmata, or Pio’s knowing participation in any counterfeit relic. Chicken-blood claim in the interview lacks recovered underlying assay or incident documentation.

records.complaint: Insufficient conformity to religious discipline, excessive attachment to devotees and resistance to reforms of appointments, publicity and governance.
records.basis: Luzzatto, printedp392, quoting Holy Office1960judgment and Maccari recommendations.
records.limit: Distinguish disciplinary assessment from medical cause; retain Pio’s age/health and defenders’ explanations.

records.complaint: Bignami proposed pathological lesions with possible chemical maintenance; Gemelli proposed a psychological/natural interpretation.
records.basis: Published Bignami report in Di Flumeri; Vatican Radio2009historical summary for Gemelli’s lack of direct wound examination.
records.limit: Hypotheses, not witnessed puncturing. Bignami did not establish straightforward deliberate simulation. Chemical challenge already adjudicated separately and not reopened merely by repetition.

sources.finding: Both Maccari and Bortignon heard ex officio; website chronology errors require cross-check with official Vatican dates

sources.limits: Church-side published reconstruction; whole original depositions remain uninspected. Distinguish formal witness, historical record, administrative investigation request and surveillance participation.
